name: DynamicGUIBench
notes: The Hub repository is named osworld_env; its card titles the release DynamicGUIBench. The manifest at revision 44adf69d holds 500 task JSON files under dynamic/ plus per-application asset folders and three stray .nfs files; it contains no agent code. The card states that its Qwen3-VL and UI-TARS results come from the original 150-task release and do not carry over to the 500-task expansion. Tasks run in a separately configured OSWorld environment. No data license is declared.
summary: Desktop benchmark of 500 OSWorld-style tasks whose interfaces change between observations through scripted pop-ups, timed edits and shifting lists, with bilingual instructions and end-state evaluators.
